trainStudy: OSD-46 (Affymetrix ATH1 microarray, Wild Type + atm-1)

withinStudyReference.practicalMeaning: The 95% interval spans chance, so this study's own irradiated-vs-control contrast is not learnable by this pipeline. A cross-study negative against such a target cannot distinguish a harmonisation failure from the absence of a signal to transfer.

decisionRule: adopt only if held-out balanced accuracy > 0.5 with non-zero recall for both classes; beating 0.667 accuracy by predicting one class is not a result

phase9ResultPreserved.note: Phase 9's 16-setting sweep remains the reference for the z-score harmonisation and is not superseded.

interpretation: Rank and quantile mappings discard scale but keep ordering; pathway modules discard gene identity entirely. If none of the three recovers control recall, the failure is not a transform artefact but a difference in what the two experiments measured.
